native_paragraphs: Library pickup instructions
This fictional library example explains how to collect reserved books. Choose a pickup location and wait for a ready notice before travelling.
Collection deadline
Uncollected books return to the shelf after 3 days. A ready notice does not extend this deadline.
How to collect
Submit a request with your name and pickup location.
Wait for the library to review the request and send a ready notice.
Bring your library card when collecting the books.
Pickup locations
Request progress
Reference link for this fictional example: Pickup information

decision.scope: Known six-example discrimination only; broader qualification and target readiness unverified; user review pending

limitations: Known examples; same assistant authored fixtures and assessed results, with user-approved expectations.
C4 is unblinded visual assessment, not autonomous visual checker validation.
C1 checks expected text presence and heading order, not arbitrary added content, all list ordering or semantic style preservation.
C2 covers one simple native table; merged/nested tables are outside scope.
C5 uses Word automation, not a human UI editing trial.
MD-O04/05/06 remain unverified; no MarkdownToDocx execution or modification.
Six exposed examples do not estimate deployment reliability or prove SkillForge improvement.

Publication adaptation replaces one private checker path and omits disposable edited copies; original checker identity is preserved in publication-manifest.json. Raw observation receipts are unchanged.
